body:
## What to build

Preserve omitted-argument semantics when a tidy-evaluation wrapper forwards an empty argument through redundant parentheses, both at the public selection arguments and inside a Grouping specification.

On main snapshot 13dd7c30ac38fe3fc82e74c561d8795a6c4b6d17, forwarding an omitted x directly to `.by` or `.grouping` with embrace worked, as the documented empty/default case requires. Adding redundant parentheses around the embraced argument made all five consumers fail instead: inspection and all four Margin verbs, in both positions (10 false refusals). The errors named internal variables expr or grouping_spec.

Inside a constructor, a wrapper taking an argument x and forwarding it, embraced and parenthesized, as the first argument of grouping_sets before a real column a leaked an R missing-argument error when x was omitted. The message was `argument "expr" is missing, with no default`, and the blamed call named the internal nested_arg_quosure helper. Removing the redundant parentheses, or forwarding an explicitly captured quosure with injection, instead produced the intended `marginplyr_error` identifying argument 1 of grouping_sets as empty and blaming the public verb.

The same defect reproduced for all five Grouping specification constructors through Grouping-plan inspection and all four Margin verbs: 25 public-interface combinations. The nested-quosure reader opened a previously nonempty quosure after the sole empty-argument check, then forced its missing payload through a local named expr. The constructor failure and public `.grouping` failure occurred before tidyselect was invoked; the public `.by` failure reached tidyselect after marginplyr missed its own empty-argument interpretation.

The documented Nested specification position treats redundant parentheses as transparent and refuses an empty argument by constructor and position. ADR 0015 owns the Package-condition boundary. The earlier fix for parenthesized injected nested specifications (#897) covered nonempty payloads and did not cover this missing-payload shape.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An omitted argument forwarded with embrace inside redundant parentheses to `.by` or `.grouping` behaves exactly like the corresponding unparenthesized/default call, through all five public consumers.
- [ ] The same empty forwarding inside a constructor is refused as an empty constructor argument with `marginplyr_error`.
- [ ] The diagnostic identifies the constructor and argument position, retains the public API call context, and exposes no internal expr-missing error.
- [ ] Cover all five constructors through inspection and all four Margin verbs, including an interior omitted argument followed by a real column.
- [ ] Direct empty arguments, explicitly injected missing quosures, parenthesized missing payloads, and valid nonempty injected nested specifications keep their documented behavior.
- [ ] Nested-argument evaluation counts, captured environments, trailing-comma behavior, and lazy-input early-validation guarantees are preserved.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).
